result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback: it is mutual, applies only to personnel directly involved in the Services, lasts 12 months from each individual’s involvement, excludes general or untargeted recruitment and unsolicited approaches, and prohibits solicitation rather than hiring. It also resolves the conflict with Section 12.3 and otherwise preserves the agreement’s commercial intent. The carve-out wording is slightly awkward but professionally adequate.
